title: Anthropic says a malicious actor used access to Cursor's marketplace to publish a "tampered" copy of the Claude Code extension, which it didn't build or publish (Felix Rieseberg/@felixrieseberg)
summary: Felix Rieseberg / @felixrieseberg: Anthropic says a malicious actor used access to Cursor's marketplace to publish a “tampered” copy of the Claude Code extension, which it didn't build or publish — We're working with Cursor on this incident, but it wasn't a compromise of Anthropi
reason: Item reports a supply-chain security incident: a tampered Claude Code extension published via Cursor's marketplace. It is not a model release, research result, business event (financing/M&A/partnership/market data), policy action, or open-source tool release, so no active rule covers it.
